name: Solutions needing consideration named, recall first
purpose: Every solution a request needs considered is named, and few that do not, at what cost.
record: Per arm, cases passed (every gold solution named and at least a quarter of the named ones gold) out of cases run, with mean recall and mean precision, on the hub's relevance cases (evaluation/relevant_solutions: mined from the hub's history and hand-labelled requests).
disadvantages: A commit subject is shorter and more technical than a request; a commit that touched a file for an unrelated reason labels a solution that did not need consideration.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=a change to the arm or the records index] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=a cheap model classifier arm exists] > sample [sample=sample:10 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the model arm passed its one case]
